purpose: Document Santa Marta local cadastral custody and bounded anonymous official-service checks without treating an exact-point miss, timeout, Cloudflare challenge, or jurisdiction mismatch as parcel absence.
assessment: Santa Marta's local cadastral custodian is evidenced by the official Catastro Multipropósito site and the official IGAC gestor registry. The official IGAC U_TERRENO service exposes polygon metadata and safe identity candidates, but the exact WUP point returned zero features and a bounded city envelope timed out. The municipal observatory returned a Cloudflare managed challenge to direct shell retrieval. No parcel geometry was retained; runtime qualification remains held.
registryAssessment: The Distrito Turístico, Cultural e Histórico de Santa Marta operates as an enabled cadastral gestor (DIVIPOLA 47001, estado EN OPERACION) according to the official IGAC Gestores_Catastrales service. The local Catastro Multipropósito Santa Marta website provides cadastral certificates, cadastral maps and cadastral plans. This is local registry/cadastre evidence, not proof of an open parcel API.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Santa Marta cadastral site/products, municipal real-estate observatory, official IGAC gestor registry, IGAC open-data documentation, and official IGAC U_TERRENO service.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Local cadastral custody and public product pages; U_TERRENO schema/CRS/query capability; no Santa Marta-specific parcel response.

officialPrimarySources.operator: Catastro Multipropósito Santa Marta / Alcaldía de Santa Marta
officialPrimarySources.observation: Official local cadastral authority site with local contact, cadastral services and links to products/observatory.
Lists certificates, cadastral maps and cadastral plans as official local products.

officialPrimarySources.operator: Observatorio Inmobiliario Catastral de Santa Marta
officialPrimarySources.observation: Official municipal page describes interactive maps for transactions, urban sectors, perimeter and ZHG layers; direct GET encountered Cloudflare managed challenge.
Query for 47001 returned Santa Marta's district cadastral gestor and EN OPERACION status.

U_TERRENO polygon layer metadata: public ArcGIS REST query formats JSON/GeoJSON/PBF; safe candidate fields FID, CODIGO, GLOBALID_S, GlobalID; official layer CRS metadata is available from the service, while response geometry CRS was requested as EPSG:4326.
Official open-data documentation describes cadastral coverage and distinguishes IGAC jurisdiction from other cadastral gestores.

attempts: Fetched the official local Catastro Multipropósito Santa Marta homepage anonymously over verified TLS and inspected the current Next.js HTML/chunk references for public map/API configuration.
Fetched official local certificate, cadastral-map and cadastral-plan product routes anonymously; pages were readable but did not expose a machine-readable parcel feature response.
Fetched the official municipal observatory map route anonymously; received a Cloudflare managed challenge. No CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass or browser challenge solving was attempted.
Queried official IGAC Gestores_Catastrales layer for mpcodigo 47001 with safe custody fields only; received one operating Santa Marta district gestor record.
Fetched official IGAC U_TERRENO ArcGIS REST metadata; recorded polygon type, query formats and safe candidate identity fields.
Queried U_TERRENO at exact WUP point [11.2345904677867, -74.1864107381004] without shifting coordinates; returned zero features.
Queried U_TERRENO over bounded Santa Marta envelope -74.22,11.20,-74.15,11.27 with a three-record cap; request timed out after 25 seconds and returned no geometry.
Attempted public IGAC open-data GDB download from the official ArcGIS item; transfer timed out during a multi-gigabyte incomplete scratch download and was not treated as Santa Marta evidence.
No login, credentials, private token, unsafe owner/address/titleholder field, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS-verification exception was used.

remainingUncertainty: The district cadastral website may have a separate authenticated or undiscovered service backend, and the IGAC public U_TERRENO layer may not cover this non-IGAC gestor jurisdiction. The exact-point empty result, envelope timeout, and observatory challenge do not establish parcel absence or lack of citywide coverage.
